1) Please take a 10–15m pass through the MAP and add any missing stakeholders (security, procurement, infra).
2) Would Friday 11/14, 10:00–11:00 PT work for the Week‑0 workshop? If not, share two windows that work for you.
3) Any procurement requirements we should surface ahead of the meeting (PO timeline, internal review owners)?
